soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.58–0.61, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin slightly arcuately convex outwards. The frontal ridge is very slightly raised, with a shallow interfrontal depression. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, the semi-transparent apical region projecting like a nipple, both the apical and subapical hairs rather long. The mandibles are rather stout and straight, their apices short and slightly curved; the mandibular length 0.57–0.59 times the head capsule length and 0.97–0.98 times the head width. Antennae with 16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the anterolateral margins parallel and then expanding, the waist region slender and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.28–0.33. The pronotum is trapezoidal, about 1.63–1.73 times as wide as long, the anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the median notch of the anterior margin deeper than that of the posterior, with about six hairs in the middle region.
